sn46.40:1.1: pañcime bhikkhave, nīvaraṇā andhakaraṇā acakkhukaraṇā aññāṇakaraṇā paññānirodhiyā vighāta pakkhiyā anibbānasaṃvattanikā.
sn46.40:1.3: kāmacchandanīvaraṇaṃ bhikkhave, andhakaraṇaṃ acakkhukaraṇaṃ aññāṇakaraṇaṃ paññānirodhiyaṃ vighātapakkhiyaṃ anibbānasaṃvattanikaṃ.
sn46.40:1.7: vicikicchānīvaraṇaṃ bhikkhave, andhakaraṇaṃ acakkhukaraṇaṃ aññāṇakaraṇaṃ paññānirodhiyaṃ vighātapakkhiyaṃ anibbānasaṃvattanikaṃ.
sn46.40:1.8: ime kho bhikkhave, pañcanīvaraṇā andhakaraṇā acakkhukaraṇā aññāṇakaraṇā paññānirodhiyā vighātapakkhiyā anibbānasaṃvattanikā.
sn46.40:2.1: sattime bhikkhave, bojjhaṅgā cakkhukaraṇā ñāṇakaraṇā paññāvuddhiyā avighātapakkhiyā nibbānasaṃvattanikā.
sn46.40:2.3: satisambojjhaṅgo bhikkhave, cakkhukaraṇo ñāṇakaraṇo paññāvuddhiyo avighātapakkhiyo nibbānasaṃvattaniko -pe- upekhāsambojjhaṅgo bhikkhave, cakkhukaraṇo ñāṇakaraṇo paññāvuddhiyo avighātapakkhiyo nibbānasaṃvattaniko.
sn46.40:2.4: ime kho bhikkhave sattabojjhaṅgā cakkhukaraṇā ñāṇakaraṇā paññāvuddhiyā avighātapakkhiyā nibbānasaṃvattanikāti.
